description: LiDAR -> vehicle (radar) frame per mounting: p_vehicle = Rz(yaw_deg) * p_lidar + (tx_m, ty_m). Read by perception/core/extrinsic.py. Sessions before the first valid_from use identity.

mountings.z_note: z is not shifted (the radar has no elevation for stationary targets; the LiDAR detector measures its own ground)
mountings.method: Yaw referenced to the CAMERA (the rig's forward direction): camera azimuth of the corner reflector (top of the tripod, found by image difference from the background session; atan((cx - u) / fx), rectified intrinsics) minus its LiDAR azimuth in the LiDAR's own frame (background-subtracted voxels), 9 positions at 2-5 m of calibration_dataset 2026-11-03: +37.20 +- 0.39 deg (calib_reflector.py). Translation from the 2D rigid fit to the 13 nominal positions. The radar boresight reads 2.7 deg right of the camera on the same positions; the nominal positions give 39.76 deg (the rig was turned ~2.5 deg against the floor marks); the team's manual radar-based fit gave 38.6 deg.
mountings.measured: 2026-11-05, yaw revised 2026-11-07 (was 39.76, fitted to the nominal positions)
mountings.provisional: until the team's extrinsic calibration is accepted
